newsitem.title: USA: Credit Suisse awards account to Doremus.
newsitem.headline: Credit Suisse awards account to Doremus.

text.p: Credit Suisse First Boston said on Monday it has awarded its worldwide advertising account to Doremus Advertising.
A $15 million global advertising campaign debuts this week, portraying the dynamic strength of Credit Suisse First Boston in ways that depart dramatically from traditional financial advertising.
Credit Suisse First Boston was formed from investment bank CS First Boston and Credit Suisse's corporate banking operations, the company said.
Doremus Advertising has created the first global campaign in nine languages to communicate Credit Suisse First Boston's expanded services and new positioning, Credit Suisse said.
Doremus is a unit of Omnicom Group Inc.
